coverage.found: No current FBiH rules on construction diary/book or contractor licensing surfaced; FBiH spatial planning law amendments with e-permits were only drafts (2022-2023 news), status unknown. Kanton Sarajevo spatial law (Apr 2025) is cantonal. Nothing usable.

coverage.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
coverage.found: State-level AML/CFT Law, Sl. glasnik BiH 13/2024 (19 Feb 2024); real estate agents/brokers, notaries, lawyers and accountants are obliged entities (authorised person + deputy, risk assessment, internal procedures, 5-year records). A guide for real estate dealers was published on fuzip.gov.ba in March 2026 (partly read from PDF: mentions transactions above 30,000 KM and cash limits; exact thresholds unverified). Implementing rulebook adopted by the Council of Ministers (paragraf.ba 5 Jan 2026). FATF/MONEYVAL pressure: 1-year observation period from Feb 2025, grey-list risk. No local AML software vendor found. See C1.

coverage.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
coverage.found: RS: central electronic guest/tourist registration system (eTurizam, eturizam.vladars.rs) in use from 1 Jan 2026; tourist tax law amended 1 Jan 2025 (1.5-3 KM, private accommodation now covered). FBiH: cantonal e-registration system prijava.ba, presented Oct 2025, now covering all ten cantons (Feb 2026 report), mandatory in Herzegovina-Neretva Canton. Free state systems cover the core duty. See C8 (rejected). FBiH tourist tax law revision only at pre-draft stage (2025).

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: Wood EUDR digital traceability: TI BiH (Feb 2026) warns BiH wood products cannot cross the border without EUDR-aligned traceability (known K02). BiH has EU approval for fish, honey, hides, sugar exports (old EEAS source); no current establishment list or exporter register found. Nothing new beyond K02.

coverage.category: 31. Agricultural holding register (RPG) and farm subsidy applications
coverage.found: FBiH Government adopted the 2026 agricultural support program in late April 2026 worth 190 million KM (paragraf.ba 27 Apr 2026); draft program (fmpvs.gov.ba, Feb 2026) requires entry in the Register of Agricultural Holdings / Register of Clients, beekeepers also in the Beekeepers' Register. RS 2026 program not found. See C4.

coverage.category: 32. Renewable energy: prosumers and solar installers (FBiH/RS)
coverage.found: FBiH prosumer category since 2023; installation by an authorised installer; OIEiEK operator public call for household prosumer subsidies (4 million KM, 50-100% co-financing, reported 2 Oct 2026); FBiH renewables law draft with auctions 2025-2030. RS VAT mismatch reported 2024. Installer authorisation rules and energy certificate duty not found. See C5.

coverage.category: 33. FBiH Law on Fiscalization of Transactions and B2B/B2C/B2G e-invoicing
coverage.found: Law published Sl. novine FBiH 9/2026 (4 Feb 2026); full application by 31 Aug 2027; ESET software model with real-time reporting; Tax Administration FBiH RFI May 2026, by-laws due about Aug 2026. Same duty and buyer group as K06/K03/K10. No RS e-invoicing duty found. See C9 (known).

coverage.category: 34. Packaging waste and extended producer responsibility (FBiH)
coverage.found: FBiH Rulebook on packaging and packaging waste (Sl. novine FBiH 88/2011, 28/2013, 103/2016, 84/2017; a 2016 notice says an earlier version ceased to apply, so current text unclear). Producers, importers, fillers, distributors can transfer duties by contract to an authorised operator (Ekopak named as first operator). Producer-level reporting forms/deadlines not found. See C6 (unverified).

coverage.category: 35. Employment of persons with disabilities: quota and special contribution (FBiH)
coverage.found: FBiH draft law on professional rehabilitation and employment of persons with disabilities (parliament, Mar 2025) would strengthen the Fund, tighten collection of the special contribution from all legal entities and add an employer self-service app. Adoption not confirmed. See C7.

coverage.category: 36. Narcotics list changes and medical cannabis (state level)
coverage.found: Nov 2025 draft amendment to the list of narcotics, psychotropic substances and precursors would move cannabis to the strictly controlled table; initiative by Ministry of Civil Affairs; adoption not confirmed. No licensing regime for growers found. See C12 (unverified).
